subject: Draft MAP & trial measurement matrix for Veridian Health
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@veridian.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Draft MAP & trial measurement matrix for Veridian Health

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for a great conversation last week. Per our discussion I put together an editable MAP + a lightweight trial measurement matrix so we can align on objectives, owners, and a realistic close path. I attached two stubs: Redwood_MAP_template_v1.gdoc (co-editable) and Trial_Metrics_matrix.xlsx (metric definitions + data owners).

High-level proposal (30-day pilot -> decision):
- Week 0 (kickoff): security & access, data samples, baseline latency/cost metrics capture
- Week 1: integration + quick perf checks on 3 representative flows
- Week 2: focused quality evals (privacy-sensitive prompts + edge cases)
- Week 3: load/throughput validation + final acceptance checklist
- Decision meeting: executive sync + procurement next steps

Key asks from your side: security contact for SOC2 artifact transfer, list of 3 priority flows, and any SSO/KMS constraints.

Can you open the MAP doc (link below) and drop preferred owners/times? If you like, I can propose a sprint-by-sprint owner roster by tomorrow.

Links / attachments:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/d/1MAP_TEMPLATE_v1
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/VER-4821
- Attachments: Redwood_MAP_template_v1.gdoc, Trial_Metrics_matrix.xlsx

Proposed kickoff slots: Tue 4/14 10–11am PT, Wed 4/15 2–3pm PT.

Thanks — looking forward to co-authoring the MAP.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Sasha Patel <sasha@veridian.ai>

Date: 2026-04-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & trial measurement matrix for Veridian Health

Karthik —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the templates. I shared the Drive link internally and looped Tom (procurement) — he can shepherd the SOW and payment cadence. A couple notes from our side:

- Security: we need the SOC2 report and a short note on data retention controls; can you route those to security@veridian.ai?
- Priority flows: (1) patient intake form autocompletion, (2) chart summarization, (3) billing code suggestion.
- KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys, but can evaluate a Redwoods-hosted key if you provide controls.

Tom — can you do Tue 4/14 10am PT for kickoff? If not, Wed 4/15 2pm PT also works.

On the MAP: the team would like acceptance criteria attached to each milestone (pass/fail thresholds). Also want a short success metric by owner (e.g., reduction in human review time, error rate).

Thanks — Sasha
VP Product, Veridian Health
Sasha Patel <sasha@veridian.ai>

Thanks Sasha — great notes. Tom, welcome — appreciate you joining. Tue 4/14 10am PT works for us; I booked a 60-minute kickoff and shared a calendar invite (please accept).

Actionable updates I made in the MAP doc (shared):
- Added an acceptance-criteria column next to each milestone (pass/fail + owner).
- Populated the trial metrics tab with the three priority flows Sasha listed — suggested baseline capture scripts and sample sizes.
- Noted KMS preference; we can propose an options table (CMK vs Redwood-managed) and a short migration path.

Security artifacts: attaching a stub list and I can route the SOC2 latest public report to security@veridian.ai once I confirm the NDA path (see Veridian_SOW_stub.pdf). If Tom can confirm the contact for secure artifact exchange, we’ll send the assets by EOD.

Quick MAP skeleton (copied into email for visibility):
- Kickoff (Owner: Karthik) — access + security handshake (criteria: access to 3 sample datasets, SOC2 exchange completed)
- Integration (Owner: Jasmine) — SDK/streaming integration + sample inference run (criteria: 3 flows run with <200ms median tail)
- Quality (Owner: Marissa) — evals on edge scenarios (criteria: F-measure > threshold per flow)
- Performance (Owner: Karthik) — throughput/load test (criteria: sustain target qps w/ <5% error)
- Decision (Owners: Sasha/Tom) — exec review + purchase order

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_template_v1.gdoc (editable), Trial_Metrics_matrix.xlsx, Veridian_SOW_stub.pdf

If that skeleton looks good, I’ll lock the Week 0 owners and convert the doc to a shared sprint board before kickoff.

—
Karthik

Date: 2026-04-15T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: MAP redlines & measurement suggestions (internal only)

Karthik / Jasmine —

Internal notes ahead of tomorrow's kickoff: please see inline below (I copied the MAP doc sections into the Drive and made comments). High level:

1) Acceptance thresholds — tighten the language on chart summarization (we should specify ROUGE-L and human spot-check sample size rather than vague F-measure).
2) Security handoff — ask Tom if Veridian will accept a time-limited read-only link to the SOC2 or requires a vendor portal upload. That changes our delivery path.
3) Measurement owner matrix — attach a single-sheet owner + runbook (I drafted Trial_Metrics_matrix.xlsx with columns: metric, owner, collection script, baseline window).
4) Contingency — add fallback model variant (lower-cost quantized) to the performance milestone to keep latency under SLO if their sample results spike.

I'll be on the kickoff; planning to lead the Quality section. Karthik — can you confirm you will present the performance targets in the 10–15 minute tech deep-dive?

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
